title: Western Conference consolidates power; East dominates bottom of charts
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 4
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Jazz have been too good, with or without Kirilenko, to drop them after a road loss on a back-to-back. They've been 5-0 good with Kirilenko sitting out, in fact.

rankings.summaryHtml: Can't ignore the fact that only three victims in Mavs' 9-0 surge have winning records. But don't ignore the fact that Howard missed all but two of those games.

rankings.summaryHtml: Losing yet another nail-biter with Dallas, Spurs can live with. Losing Ginobili on a hard fall, when he wasn't at his best to begin with, was much more disconcerting.

rankings.summaryHtml: Suns aren't just starting to heat up. They're 6-1 since a 1-5 start and they're starting to get Amare, Diaw and Matrix on the court. Together. As a frontcourt trio.

rankings.summaryHtml: Van Gundy speaks out against the ''Rocket hate'' he keeps hearing. But I'm guessing he'll gradually be able to tune it out if Yao and T-Mac can win nine of every 13.

rankings.summaryHtml: Who needs a smooth training camp? Lakers continue to make the most of this home-heavy early schedule and, as a bonus, sent Clippers into a spiral.
